About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

AI agents — both the ones we ship to customers and the ones our engineers use to build Slack — are fundamentally changing how data gets created, queried, and acted upon. We are seeking a leader who can transform our data engineering stack from a traditional analytics platform into the foundation for agentic analytics (AI agents that autonomously explore, analyze, and surface insights from data) and agentic development (AI-powered engineering tools that use data infrastructure as their backbone).

As Senior Director of Data Engineering, you will lead a ~40-person organization and own the full data engineering stack — from infrastructure and ingestion through to data products, semantic layers, and AI-facing data services. You'll partner closely with Data Science & Analytics as a strategic peer while driving a bold technical vision: making Slack's data platform the best-in-class substrate for both human analysts and AI agents. This is not a maintenance role. We're looking for someone who sees the agentic future of data platforms and wants to build it.

What You'll Build (Transform)

Architect the data layers agents rely on— Design and ship data APIs, MCP servers, and semantic interfaces that let AI agents (Slackbot AI, internal coding agents, customer-built Agentforce agents) query, reason over, and act on Slack's data autonomously
Transform the semantic layer — Evolve our metrics platform from a human-query tool into a machine-readable knowledge that agents can navigate, with governed metric definitions, lineage, and natural-language access patterns
Build real-time data products — Move beyond batch analytics to streaming data infrastructure that supports sub-second agent decision-making, real-time experimentation, and low-latency retrieval
Ship agentic analytics tooling — Create the next generation of self-serve analytics where AI agents draft queries, detect anomalies, generate insights, and surface recommendations — replacing manual dashboard-watching with proactive, agent-driven intelligence
Establish AI-native observability — Instrument the data stack with LLM-aware tracing (OpenTelemetry GenAI conventions), token/cost attribution, and quality metrics that treat AI agents as first-class consumers of data infrastructure
Drive the Data MCP strategy — Own the vision for how Slack's data warehouse, metrics layer, and analytics tools are exposed to AI agents via MCP servers, making Slack's data the most agent-accessible enterprise dataset in the industry

What You'll Run (Operate)

Own and unify the Data Engineering roadmap across infrastructure, ingestion, data governance, tooling, semantic layer sub-teams
Serve as the DRI for data engineering, representing data engineering in leadership planning and resolving cross-team priority conflicts
Partner directly with the Data Science & Analytics organization — establishing and running an effective operating model
Set data freshness SLAs, warehouse reliability, and cost optimization standards across ingestion and infrastructure teams and ensure the data platform meets those standards and goals
Build and scale engineering capacity — hire, develop and retain top EM and senior IC talents
Champion a strong data engineering identity and culture
Partner with product, infrastructure, and DevXP leadership on cross-cutting initiatives

Minimum Qualifications

10+ years of experience in data engineering, data platform, or infrastructure engineering roles, including 5+ years in engineering leadership at the Director level or above
Proven track record building and scaling data platforms (ingestion pipelines, warehousing, semantic/metrics layers) at consumer or enterprise SaaS scale
Experience leading through organizational change — team consolidations, re-orgs, or multi-team integrations
Demonstrated success partnering with Data Science / Analytics leadership as a peer stakeholder
Strong track record of hiring, developing, and retaining engineering managers and senior ICs
Excellent cross-functional communication skills, with experience presenting technical vision and strategy to executive stakeholders
A related technical degree required

Preferred Qualifications

Experience building data platforms that serve AI/ML workloads — not just dashboards and reports, but data infrastructure optimized for model training, feature serving, RAG retrieval, or agent-driven queries
Hands-on understanding of how LLMs and AI agents consume data — including semantic layers, embeddings, vector search, tool-use patterns (MCP, function calling), and structured vs. unstructured data access
Experience with agentic systems, AI-assisted analytics, or building developer tools powered by AI (e.g., AI coding assistants, automated data quality, natural-language-to-SQL)
Track record shipping data-as-a-product — APIs, SDKs, or self-serve platforms where internal or external developers are the primary consumers
Experience operating a "pod" or embedded working model that pairs engineering with data science/analytics
Familiarity with modern data stack components: warehouse infrastructure, streaming ingestion, semantic/metrics layers (governance, OLAP systems, Airflow-like orchestration)
Experience running experimentation platforms and A/B testing infrastructure at scale

added.description:
We’re building a world of health around every individual — shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger – helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.

Health100 is recruiting for a VP, Digital Engineering to lead cross-functional engineering capabilities for the Health100 platform, spanning digital identity and account management, payments, solutions engineering, and AI solutions. This is a highly technical and strategic leadership role where this leader will not only manage the teams delivering new features and capabilities but also guide architectural direction and digital best practices to future-proof the platform. The ideal candidate operates as a true partner to Product — co-owning the roadmap and capability definition in addition to executing against it. This leader brings a builder's instinct for moving fast, cutting through ambiguity, and shipping solutions. We're looking for someone who can bring a startup-caliber sense of urgency and ownership to an enterprise-scale platform, positioning Health100 as an industry-leading consumer health experience.

You Will Make An Impact By

Partnering directly with Product leadership to define and shape the Health100 roadmap and capability set — not just receiving requirements, but co-driving what gets built, in what sequence, and why.
Leading a portfolio of cross-cutting engineering capabilities that underpin the Health100 member experience, including digital account and profile management, digital payments, solutions engineering, and AI solutions.
Owning engineering for digital account and profile capabilities — registration, authentication, identity verification, profile and preference management, and consent/privacy controls (including CCPA/CPRA opt-out flows across authenticated and unauthenticated users) — ensuring a secure, unified member identity experience.
Owning digital payments engineering across Health100, including premium and copay payment flows, HSA/FSA integration, and third-party payment processor and billing system integrations, with a strong focus on PCI-DSS compliance and transaction reliability.
Leading the Solutions Engineering function: translating product and business requirements into technical designs, cross-team integration patterns, and reusable frameworks/accelerators that let feature teams ship consistently and quickly across Health100.
Leading AI Solutions engineering for Health100 — building and scaling Generative AI and agentic capabilities (conversational assistants, intelligent workflow automation) designed to be incremental and invisible in the member experience rather than disruptive.
Owning production reliability and operability across the portfolio — defining SLOs/SLAs, leading incident response and on-call practices, and ensuring performance and resiliency against enterprise uptime targets across identity, payment, and AI transaction volumes.
Driving a bias toward action: favoring rapid iteration, lean process, and pragmatic build/buy decisions over lengthy planning cycles, while still meeting the rigor a regulated healthcare environment demands.
Working closely with other engineering leaders across CVS Health's vertically integrated ecosystem (Caremark, Aetna, CVS Specialty) to ensure Health100 capabilities integrate cleanly with adjacent platforms over time.
Managing and supporting a large team of engineering resources, building a culture of ownership, urgency, and product-based delivery, and helping tenured resources transition to new delivery methodologies.
Tracking and adhering to financial, operational, and other OKRs/goals within and across the organization. .

Requirements

15+ years of experience in digital software development and engineering
10+ years overall in a Technology leadership position, including managing financials, goals, and operational metrics
Background as a hands-on software engineer or architect earlier in career, with continued fluency in code and system design
Experience leading multiple engineering teams totaling 100+ resources
Experience in coding, architecting and leading large teams of technologists across multiple time zones and cultures
Track record of partnering closely with Product to shape roadmap and capability strategy, not just execute against a fixed backlog
Demonstrated ability to drive fast, high-quality execution — shipping and iterating in tight cycles rather than over-planning
Deep expertise in software architecture, APIs, microservices, cloud-native platforms, and DevSecOps
Previous experience in design, architecture, and engineering of highly available, resilient, scalable systems, including cloud architectures
Experience building enterprise transaction-based systems with focus on security, reliability, scalability, performance, and modern CI/CD techniques
Experience owning production reliability at enterprise scale — defining and meeting SLOs/SLAs, leading incident response, and building strong observability practices
Experience with digital identity and account management systems (OAuth 2.0/OIDC or equivalent)
Experience with digital payments systems and PCI-DSS compliance
Experience delivering AI, ML, or Generative AI solutions within enterprise software environments
Experience with LLM evaluation frameworks, RAG architecture, and agent orchestration platforms, including model governance and responsible AI practices
Experience supporting digital platforms with large daily visitor volumes (1M+ visits/day)
Demonstrated experience in taking high-level enterprise strategy and blueprints and converting them into system-level deliverables for delivery
Experience working in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, with the ability to adapt to change and lead through ambiguity
Demonstrated success in driving innovation and continuous improvement
Strong interpersonal and communication skills, effectively communicating key messages to executive leaders and internal/external stakeholders

Preferred Qualifications

Startup, high-growth, or 0-to-1 product-building experience, ideally brought into and adapted for a large enterprise setting
Healthcare, pharmacy, payer, provider, or digital health experience
Experience with LLMs, agentic architecture, conversational AI, and intelligent workflow automation

added.description:
Job Family

About Us

At Transamerica, hard work, innovative thinking, and personal accountability are qualities we honor and reward. We understand the potential of leveraging the talents of a diverse workforce. We embrace an environment where employees enjoy a balance between their careers, families, communities, and personal interests.

Ultimately, we appreciate the uniqueness of a company where talented professionals work collaboratively in a positive environment — one focused on helping people look forward and plan for the best life possible while providing tools and solutions that make it easier to get there.

Who We Are

We believe everyone deserves to live their best life. More than a century ago, we were among the first financial services companies in America to serve everyday people from all walks of life.

Today, we’re part of an international holding company, with millions of customers and thousands of employees worldwide. Our insurance, retirement, and investment solutions help people make the most of what’s important to them.

We’re empowered by a vast agent network covering North America, with diversity to match. Together with our nonprofit research institute and foundation, we tune in, step up, and are a force for good — for our customers and the communities where we live, work, and play. United in our purpose, we help people create the financial freedom to live life on their terms.

What We Do

Transamerica is organized into three distinct businesses. These include 1) World Financial Group, including Transamerica Financial Advisors, 2) Protection Solutions and Savings & Investments, comprised of life insurance, annuities, employee benefits, retirement plans, and Transamerica Investment Solutions, and 3) Financial Assets, which includes legacy blocks of long term care, universal life, and variable and fixed annuities. These are supported by Transamerica Corporate, which includes Finance, People and Places, General Counsel, Risk, Internal Audit, Strategy and Development, and Corporate Affairs, which covers Communications, Brand, and Government and Policy Affairs.

Transamerica employs nearly 7,000 people. It’s part of Aegon, an integrated, diversified, international financial services group serving approximately 23.9 million customers worldwide.* For more information, visit transamerica.com. 

Job Description Summary

Leads the technology organization supporting business units as assigned or aligned, while serving as a strategic partner to the Head of Corporate Systems and Data. This highly visible role combines enterprise technology leadership, portfolio ownership, executive stakeholder management, and operational discipline across a complex platform landscape.

Responsibilities

Job Description

Own the end-to-end technology strategy, roadmap, and delivery for business units as assigned or aligned, ensuring platforms and capabilities align with business priorities and enterprise architecture standards.
Serve as the primary technology leader for assigned or aligned business unit platforms and capabilities, ensuring integration, adoption, ongoing optimization, and alignment with enterprise technology standards.
Lead technology delivery across assigned or aligned business units, ensuring platforms scale with operational, regulatory, risk, and business requirements.
Oversee technology support, governance, tooling, and operating models for assigned or aligned business units, ensuring effective delivery and service management.
Manage the full technology portfolio budget, including capital and operating spend, vendor contracts, licensing, and resource allocation.
Own capacity and demand management across the portfolio, balancing run-the-business needs with strategic initiatives and making transparent trade-off decisions with stakeholders.
Build and maintain multi-year technology roadmaps incorporating platform modernization, AI and automation opportunities, risk reduction, and regulatory change.
Lead, develop, and grow a team of technology professionals, including managers, engineers, product/platform leads, and business analysts; establish clear career paths, performance practices, and succession plans.
Serve as a trusted technology partner to senior leaders across assigned or aligned business units, translating business needs into technology strategy and communicating complex topics in clear, business-relevant terms.
Act as a strategic partner and force multiplier for the Head of Corporate Systems and Data, driving key organizational initiatives, executive communications, operating rhythm, special projects, workforce planning, and cross-functional alignment.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree
12+ years of progressive technology leadership experience, including 5+ years managing large, complex technology organizations and multi-year budgets
Demonstrated experience leading technology for corporate, enabling, or business unit functions in a complex enterprise environment
Direct experience leading enterprise technology platforms and broader business application ecosystems, with the ability to drive integration, adoption, and continuous improvement across assigned or aligned business units
Proven ability to translate strategic planning into disciplined execution across complex portfolios, operating effectively at both vision and delivery-detail level
Exceptional stakeholder management and executive communication skills, with the ability to build trust and influence senior leaders with diverse priorities
Strong financial acumen, including budget planning, portfolio prioritization, vendor negotiation, licensing, and capacity/demand management
Demonstrated people leadership capability, including experience developing talent, building high-performing teams, and fostering accountability, continuous improvement, and customer-centric delivery
Experience managing vendor and partner relationships, including systems integrators and platform providers, to ensure quality delivery and cost efficiency
Ability to exercise discretion and sound judgement in handling confidential, sensitive, and organizational information

Preferred Qualifications

MBA or advanced degree
Experience with complex enterprise platforms, business applications, or risk and control technology environments relevant to assigned or aligned business units
Familiarity with platform governance, service management, vendor management, and technology delivery across multiple business domains
Experience acting in a chief-of-staff, business management, or executive-support capacity
Executive presence and gravitas to represent technology with senior business leaders and, where required, Board-level audiences
Comfort operating in ambiguity and creating structure, clarity, and momentum where it does not yet exist
Strong ability to balance competing priorities across multiple functions while maintaining enterprise focus and sound judgement

Working Conditions

Hybrid-Office environment (Tuesdays, Wednesdays, Thursdays)
Occasional travel ( Travel may be required for leadership meetings, business planning sessions, offsites, vendor engagements, or cross-functional governance forums

Managers may assign other duties and responsibilities as needed. The Salary for this position generally ranges between $220K - $285K. Please note that the salary range is a good faith estimate for this position and actual starting pay is determined by several factors including
qualifications, experience, geography, work location designation (in-office, hybrid, remote) and operational needs. Salary may vary above and below the stated amounts, as permitted by applicable law.

Additionally, this position is typically eligible for an Annual Bonus based on the Company Bonus Plan/Individual Performance and is at the Company’s discretion.

Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa at this time.

This is a hybrid position requiring three days in office per week in one of our hub locations (Philadelphia, PA; Cedar Rapids, IA; Denver, CO). Relocation assistance will not be provided for this position.

Enterprise Technology
is a global Aegon/Transamerica organization that enables the business to move quickly and deliver the best possible outcomes for clients, while keeping their information safe and secure.

With more than 1,000 employees across the UK, US, Netherlands, Hungary, Spain, and Hong Kong, Enterprise Technology is a diverse, global team. Our experts work across areas such as application development, information security, infrastructure, data & analytics, risk & controls, program management, and architecture. We offer a wide range of career opportunities and are committed to supporting employee development.

Curiosity is the quality we value most. Much of our work involves solving complex problems, applying knowledge in new ways, and continuously improving how we operate. As technology evolves rapidly, we look for inquisitive people who are confident challenging the status quo and helping us drive change.

The hiring organization is seeking a strategic and hands-on Director, Infrastructure & IT Operations
to lead the technology capabilities that keep digital products, cloud platforms, and internal teams secure, reliable, and productive.

This role oversees cloud infrastructure, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), production operations, bot mitigation, corporate IT, and helpdesk support, while providing architectural leadership across cloud platforms, networking, identity, observability, and operational tooling. This position spans both internal employee technology and the production infrastructure supporting high-traffic, customer-facing applications.

This is a full-time, remote position based in the United States.

Key Responsibilities

Lead teams responsible for cloud infrastructure, SRE, production operations, corporate IT, helpdesk, and bot mitigation, establishing ownership, operational standards, service-level objectives (SLOs), escalation procedures, and performance metrics.
Develop managers, technical leads, and IT staff through coaching, career development, and building a culture of accountability, documentation, automation, and continuous improvement.
Build quarterly and annual infrastructure roadmaps aligned with business priorities, growth, security, reliability, and cost, partnering with engineering, product, data, marketing, finance, HR, legal, and executive leadership.
Own the reliability, scalability, security, performance, and cost-effectiveness of cloud infrastructure, primarily within AWS.
Provide architectural leadership across cloud services, applications, APIs, networking, identity, databases, storage, observability, and integrations while establishing architecture standards, reference patterns, governance, and technical review processes.
Partner with engineering to improve deployment safety, performance, and readiness, driving automation, configuration management, and infrastructure as code.
Lead capacity planning for growth and demand spikes, eliminating single points of failure, undocumented systems, manual processes, and single-source dependencies.
Ensure production and nonproduction environments are properly separated, secured, and monitored, reviewing new systems for architectural fit, supportability, security, and total cost of ownership.
Establish and maintain service-level indicators (SLIs), SLOs, availability targets, and error-budget practices for critical systems.
Improve observability through centralized logging, metrics, distributed tracing, application performance monitoring (APM), and actionable alerting.
Lead major incident management, coordination, executive communication, root-cause analysis, and corrective-action tracking to improve mean time to detect, respond, and recover.
Develop and test backup, disaster recovery, and business continuity procedures, and establish sustainable on-call practices.
Own strategy and tooling for bot mitigation, scraping protection, automated abuse prevention, and traffic-quality management using technologies such as Cloudflare, DataDome, web application firewalls (WAFs), rate limiting, CAPTCHA alternatives, and device fingerprinting.
Partner with cross-functional teams to distinguish malicious automation from legitimate customers, search engines, partners, and approved AI crawlers, establishing monitoring and response procedures.
Oversee internal IT services and helpdesk support, establishing service-level expectations for response times, resolution times, user satisfaction, and backlog reduction.
Manage the employee technology lifecycle, including onboarding, offboarding, equipment provisioning, access management, asset recovery, and device inventory.
Standardize endpoint configuration, encryption, patching, and endpoint detection across laptops, collaboration platforms, productivity software, and telecom services.
Establish consistent identity and access management practices across corporate and production systems, implementing role-based access, least privilege, multi-factor authentication (MFA), periodic access reviews, and secure administrative account handling.
Support vulnerability remediation, security assessments, audits, vendor reviews, incident readiness, and applicable privacy requirements in partnership with legal and security teams.
Manage infrastructure, security, IT, telecom, monitoring, and support vendors, handling evaluations, contract reviews, renewals, licensing, service level agreements (SLAs), and budget management.
Improve cloud cost visibility through tagging, allocation, forecasting, tool consolidation, and contract optimization.

Required Qualifications

10+ years of experience in cloud infrastructure, SRE, platform engineering, DevOps, IT operations, or related disciplines.
5+ years of experience leading engineering or technology teams, including managing managers or technical leads.
Demonstrated experience operating high-traffic, customer-facing platforms in AWS or a comparable cloud environment.
Strong understanding of cloud architecture, networking, identity, security, observability, databases, APIs, storage, and distributed systems.
Experience managing production availability, incident response, root-cause analysis, disaster recovery, and business continuity.
Experience with infrastructure automation, configuration management, CI/CD, and infrastructure as code.
Experience managing corporate IT, employee support, endpoint management, software licensing, and access provisioning.
Experience establishing operational metrics, SLOs, and support standards.
Demonstrated ability to manage vendors, contracts, departmental budgets, and cloud costs.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate technical risks, architecture, and tradeoffs to executive audiences.

Experience with AWS services, containerized environments, infrastructure as code, centralized logging, and APM tools (such as AppDynamics).
Experience supporting large-scale consumer subscription, public-record, data-as-a-service, advertising, or ecommerce platforms.

QXO is a leading distributor and installer of building products serving an $800 billion market. The company’s mission is to modernize the building products industry through advanced technology and a best-in-class customer experience. QXO is North America’s largest distributor and installer of insulation, the second-largest distributor of roofing products, the second-largest publicly traded distributor of lumber and building materials, and the largest distributor of waterproofing products. The company is targeting $50 billion in annual revenue within the decade through accretive acquisitions and organic growth. For more information, visit QXO.com.

What You'll Do

QXO is building the technology platform for the building products distribution industry, and we are making real investments in technology to streamline our business and better serve our customers in the distribution space. The Transactions organization owns the systems customers touch when they choose us, pay us, and grow with us: retention programs, customer payment mechanisms, and account onboarding. When these systems work, revenue moves. When they do not, our customers feel it immediately.

We are hiring a Senior Manager of Software Engineering to lead multiple squads in this space. You will sit with business leaders to shape the problem, set the roadmap for your squads, and make the calls on sequencing and tradeoffs rather than waiting for finished requirements to arrive. You will own delivery of new system integrations and features that strip friction out of real business processes, and you will be measured on the business outcomes those systems produce.

You will join a technical organization actively evolving its use of AI, and push that work further in your squads. AI has the potential to reduce our waiting, experiment more quickly, and test our ideas at a rate that has historically not been possible. Your job is to expand what your squads can do without waiting on anyone, and to give engineers real ownership of their domains.

This role is for an engineering leader who does not shy away from ownership and is ready to bring clarity to problems that are not yet clearly defined. You will set a culture of urgency and high standards, hire people who raise the bar, and hold quality steady as the pace goes up. If you want to decide what matters and see it land with customers in weeks rather than quarters, this is the job.

Key Responsibilities

Bring clarity to ambiguous problem domains and drive solutions alongside business and technical partners
Go deep on technical details with your team when needed, and translate that work clearly for business stakeholders
Balance new feature delivery against operational priorities across your squads
Mentor and grow the engineers on your team
Identify and advance opportunities in AI/ML, personalization, and emerging technology that strengthen QXO's capabilities
Implement and reinforce best practices for reliability, observability, performance, scalability, and incident management

What You'll Bring

Required Qualifications

Experience:
7+ years in software engineering, including experience leading engineering teams. Proven success delivering features to market at scale. Strong foundation in distributed systems, event-driven architecture, data modeling, and data consistency (compensating transactions, aggregate boundaries, sagas).

Experience integrating with ERP accounts receivable systems
Experience integrating with payment processing providers

Experience working directly with stakeholders to identify gaps and build solutions
Experience in an enterprise environment where your core customers are often internal

At Transamerica, hard work, innovative thinking, and personal accountability are qualities we honor and reward. We understand the potential of leveraging the talents of a diverse workforce. We embrace an environment where employees enjoy a balance between their careers, families, communities, and personal interests.

Ultimately, we appreciate the uniqueness of a company where talented professionals work collaboratively in a positive environment — one focused on helping people look forward and plan for the best life possible while providing tools and solutions that make it easier to get there.

Who We Are

We believe everyone deserves to live their best life. More than a century ago, we were among the first financial services companies in America to serve everyday people from all walks of life.

Today, we’re part of an international holding company, with millions of customers and thousands of employees worldwide. Our insurance, retirement, and investment solutions help people make the most of what’s important to them.

We’re empowered by a vast agent network covering North America, with diversity to match. Together with our nonprofit research institute and foundation, we tune in, step up, and are a force for good — for our customers and the communities where we live, work, and play. United in our purpose, we help people create the financial freedom to live life on their terms.

What We Do

Transamerica is organized into three distinct businesses. These include 1) World Financial Group, including Transamerica Financial Advisors, 2) Protection Solutions and Savings & Investments, comprised of life insurance, annuities, employee benefits, retirement plans, and Transamerica Investment Solutions, and 3) Financial Assets, which includes legacy blocks of long term care, universal life, and variable and fixed annuities. These are supported by Transamerica Corporate, which includes Finance, People and Places, General Counsel, Risk, Internal Audit, Strategy and Development, and Corporate Affairs, which covers Communications, Brand, and Government and Policy Affairs.

Transamerica employs nearly 7,000 people. It’s part of Aegon, an integrated, diversified, international financial services group serving approximately 23.9 million customers worldwide.* For more information, visit transamerica.com.

Leads the technology organization supporting business units as assigned or aligned, while serving as a strategic partner to the Head of Corporate Systems and Data. This highly visible role combines enterprise technology leadership, portfolio ownership, executive stakeholder management, and operational discipline across a complex platform landscape.

Own the end-to-end technology strategy, roadmap, and delivery for business units as assigned or aligned, ensuring platforms and capabilities align with business priorities and enterprise architecture standards.

Build and maintain multi-year technology roadmaps incorporating platform modernization, AI and automation opportunities, risk reduction, and regulatory change.
Lead, develop, and grow a team of technology professionals, including managers, engineers, product/platform leads, and business analysts; establish clear career paths, performance practices, and succession plans.
Serve as a trusted technology partner to senior leaders across assigned or aligned business units, translating business needs into technology strategy and communicating complex topics in clear, business-relevant terms.
Act as a strategic partner and force multiplier for the Head of Corporate Systems and Data, driving key organizational initiatives, executive communications, operating rhythm, special projects, workforce planning, and cross-functional alignment.

Experience acting in a chief-of-staff, business management, or executive-support capacity

added.description:
Heartflow is a medical technology company advancing the diagnosis and management of coronary artery disease, the #1 cause of death worldwide, using cutting-edge technology. The flagship product—an AI-driven, non-invasive cardiac test supported by the ACC/AHA Chest Pain Guidelines called the Heartflow FFRCT Analysis—provides a color-coded, 3D model of a patient’s coronary arteries indicating the impact blockages have on blood flow to the heart. Heartflow is the first AI-driven non-invasive integrated heart care solution across the CCTA pathway that helps clinicians identify stenoses in the coronary arteries (RoadMap™Analysis), assess coronary blood flow (FFRCT Analysis), and characterize and quantify coronary atherosclerosis (Plaque Analysis). Our pipeline of products is growing and so is our team; join us in helping to revolutionize precision heartcare.

Heartflow is a publicly traded company (HTFL) that has received international recognition for exceptional strides in healthcare innovation, is supported by medical societies around the world, cleared for use in the US, UK, Europe, Japan and Canada, and has been used for more than 750,000 patients worldwide.

As IT Director, Salesforce Platform Owner, you will own the vision, roadmap, and governance of Heartflow's Salesforce ecosystem and serve as the executive liaison between IT and the business.

Salesforce at Heartflow supports more than 500 users across Commercial Operations, Medical Affairs, Clinical Research, Production, and Quality Systems. Because the platform spans both commercial teams and highly regulated functions, this role calls for a leader who can move quickly on revenue-facing priorities while holding the line on compliance and data integrity.

You will act as a thought partner to business function leaders, chair the Enterprise Salesforce Steering Committee, reconcile competing departmental priorities, and turn complex business processes into a prioritized, defensible roadmap.

Key Responsibilities

Roadmap & Governance: Chair the Enterprise Salesforce Steering Committee. Act as product owner for the platform, prioritizing investment based on business value, compliance obligations, and ROI, and communicating trade-offs transparently to stakeholders.
Business Partnership: Serve as the primary IT point of contact for department heads. Lead discovery sessions to understand their workflows in depth and translate what you learn into clear business requirements and user stories.
Cross-Functional IT Collaboration: Partner with IT development and platform teams to hand off groomed requirements for execution in an Agile/Scrum model, staying engaged through delivery.
Process Optimization & Adoption: Audit commercial and clinical workflows to find bottlenecks and manual workarounds. Champion adoption, lead User Acceptance Testing, and drive change management for new releases.
Data & Revenue Integrity: Work with business and IT teams to enforce Master Data Management practices, and ensure Salesforce (front office) and NetSuite (back office) stay integrated so data silos and reconciliation gaps don't form.
Compliance & Validation: Ensure platform changes follow Heartflow's change control, SOX, and quality system requirements, partnering with Quality and InfoSec on validation and access governance where applicable.

Qualifications & Skills

Experience: 8-10+ years in Enterprise Applications, Business Systems, or RevOps, including 3+ years in a Director-level or strategic Product Owner / Business Partner role.
Salesforce Depth: Strong functional and architectural understanding of the Salesforce ecosystem (Sales Cloud and Service Cloud required; CPQ, Health Cloud, or Revenue Cloud a significant plus).
Stakeholder Management: Be an exceptional communicator with a track record of resolving conflicting priorities and building consensus across departments with different incentives.
Industry Experience: Life Sciences, MedTech, Biotech, or another regulated public company environment (SOX, HIPAA, FDA, quality systems) strongly preferred.
Methodology: Solid grounding in Agile/Scrum and in translating ambiguous business needs into deliverables the IT development team can build.
Education: Bachelor's degree in a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
